root_cause: Repository Writer Candidate Shadow was globally triggered for every PR even though its verify job only applied to writer/* candidates. Ordinary PRs therefore allocated a workflow run that immediately skipped. Three writers already dispatched Shadow explicitly, while four still relied on the global trigger.
prevention: All seven repository writers must dispatch Candidate Shadow explicitly with immutable PR number, base SHA, head SHA and candidate branch. Candidate Shadow is workflow_dispatch-only. The regression test rejects any return of a global pull_request trigger or any writer that lacks explicit dispatch.
